'''Dominic Bouchard''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2000 Montreal tournament]] on 9 January 2000 with Tempest Scout operatives on Corulag, according to Dominic Gaudreault's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d165">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-quebec-montreal-09-01-00d165/ quebec-montreal-09-01-00], DeckTech (Dominic "Decktech" Gaudreault, 9 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-09-quebec-montreal-09-01-00d165/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
